groups.rationale: Entry2 is live/operating/principalOperating/nonReentrant, binds the policy before mutable token calls, captures only original source budgets/prices, repeats ownership checks, opens typed Vault context only immediately before that guarded call and clears it before approval reset. The reported before/after balance comparisons deliberately preserve prefunds and reject callback contamination; final Pricing and entry fingerprints cannot be relaxed by callbacks. Mutable callee review remains a separate dependency boundary, not guaranteed safe by a balance equality.

Manager.balance admits only the fixed Vault and is nonReentrant. It captures balance context/native+token prefunds, pulls entrant/designated funds before actual-core quote, executes at most one bounded selected swap and refunds only the remainder. Exact actual output/slot price, source budget, existing LP identity/L, runtime controls and complete prefunds are rechecked after refund callbacks. These captured balances are intended invariants; unexpected callback changes revert atomically. LP reviewer independently traced the same source6 body.

configureNative is direct-governance before/after authorization and native/terminal guarded. _configure invokes only the frozen ActivationAssets child. Its validation uses token/oracle view calls (STATICCALL), then bounded local policy writes; no mutable user-selected callback occurs at admission. Price/admission calls are for revert-on-invalid validation, not use of the returned scalar or policy ID. The new width ceiling remains below10000bps with trigger/deviation coupling. Actual source/venue/governance trust is not proved by the detector.

The request struct is read only after the emergency branch loads it. Plan p is assigned by every emergency/hybrid/full branch before use. priorLiquidity is intentionally zero with no existing LP and captured only when existingLpId is nonzero; final comparison uses that same branch.

No associated residual means exactly zero residual marked value; a nonzero secondary is separately read by its own ticks/L. _beforeMove zero-initializes Snapshot memory then assigns bucket/source/loss/control/maintenance policy/price vector/idle/value before storage; replacement/portfolio fields are set in their guarded branch, and emergency code does not accidentally gain hybrid replacement permission.

Each route iteration resets quoted=false/output=0/afterPrice=0; values are used only after a successful authenticated revert quote. lo=0 is the intentional search origin; interpolated=0 falls back to midpoint unless inside the valid bracket. Bounded reviewed venues/iterations/quote gas, actual-core delta quote, actual fees+reference checks and final Manager exact-output checks remain. target() selects ticks while captured context validates the reference; slot0 selects sqrt+directional fees while other code validates actual ticks/key. Search may fail or not find a globally optimal route; it never silently widens guards.

setGasPolicy argument names intentionally match lean public getter names. Solidity lexical scope uses those validated uint32 parameters to construct gasLimits; there is no ambiguous implicit getter invocation. Renaming only to remove detector noise is not a justified security change.

canonicalWriteHeader is fixed-writer only, sealed/inert importer only and checks no future provider rotation. The authenticated Handoff emits RecordImported for this canonical record; it is not a public silent settings setter. Imported header/records still undergo source-root equality, quota/domain and final activation validation.

Captured recipient comes from the immutable Canonical companion and fixed ProtocolPolicy. Constructor rejects zero; proposal validates candidate and acceptance cannot be zero. Sealing validates final recipient; mint binds sale+VRF, exact value and recipient/receiver callback rollback. Repeating a local zero check in the size-constrained Vault would duplicate the fixed source invariant, not close a demonstrated attacker path.

At most32 IDs; per-batch policy gas captured once. budget+60k remaining-gas test protects the inner call and tail, each current-owner payment is isolated and unpaid liabilities remain backed. At the100k-1m governed bounds the tail exceeds EIP150 withholding, but full target-network/batch gas still needs qualification; low caller gas may leave IDs unpaid without redirecting or consuming their entitlement.

Current marked assets are bounded at34 and historical reward assets at33. _historicalMarks reads only nonzero existing compound assets; _unchanged rechecks both bounds, precision and exact round/source fingerprint for every captured mark. These repeated reads intentionally protect mutable execution stages and cannot be dropped merely to satisfy calls-loop flags. Dynamic source gas and the actual worst-case set still require operating qualification.

deploymentCommitment loops16 fixed module IDs plus6 fixed ledger slots and then binds the actual ProtocolPolicy address/runtime/version/configurationHash. Inert source/import states prevent policy mutation during capture/import; destination commitment is rechecked at commit. It is a review commitment, not proof arbitrary governance-approved code is safe.

NFT mint is fixed-Vault-only, operating/principalOperating/nonReentrant. mintedCount increments before asynchronous request creation, then ID/epoch/provider reuse checks bind the result before receiver callbacks. Provider runtime and vrfRevision are checked after callbacks; Vault checks complete mint fingerprint after paying captured recipient. Authorized fulfillment only stores exact2 words and cannot finalize through the entered mint guard.

Oracle staticcall copies only exact32/160-byte results and fails on excess/failed responses; optional royalty self-call copies no revert data. Gas values come from bound policy and remain engineering limits, while exact ABI/freshness/backing/eligibility checks remain. Activation caller-underfunding reverts rather than falsely deferring a healthy full-budget call; isolated actual currency failure protects the earlier cohort.

Manager/Entry/routePlan complexity arises from explicitly distinct native/ERC20, historical typed routes, main/residual, review and emergency paths. Reviewed source branches retain bounded custody and post-callback checks; no behavior-preserving simplification was justified solely by cyclomatic score in this static refresh. Independent maintainability/security review remains useful.

These are intentional structural typed interfaces, not evidence of missing implementations or missing authorization. Current compiler closure type-checks all callers and actual bound-module/runtime/version admission is distinct. Nominal inheritance can require otherwise unnecessary struct/interface rewrites; no proven behavior/security defect justifies that refactor in this pass.

VERSION getter follows the explicit profile ABI. Literal flags concern bounded gas/USD18/wei/search constants and constructor initialization; values/bounds/units were inspected in ProtocolPolicy and LPBalancer rather than transformed to quiet the analyzer. No economic value or ceiling was changed.

Pricing marks, royalty currencies and reviewed venues have explicit bounds. Several loops cross external calls, so naive caching can alter callback-sensitive meaning. No measured material saving justifies an unverified source edit; retain existing protections and qualify worst-case gas. This is an optimization deferral, not a claim current gas is production-qualified.
